title: 反转物证 master(相框+住院手环)
prompt: Macro still-life photograph resting on a beige leather car passenger seat. Subject fills the frame: a small upright picture frame with a printed photograph inside it, and beside it a faded pale paper hospital ID wristband. Inside the picture frame's glass is a printed portrait of a smiling East Asian woman in her late twenties with long wavy black hair, a warm gentle smile, wearing a cream beige knit sweater — she exists ONLY as a small printed photo inside the frame; do not render a real woman in the car, no live person, no real human face anywhere in the scene. The wristband is a thin curled pale paper band lying on the seat beside the frame. These two objects dominate the frame. Overcast blue-cyan cold daylight, slightly high contrast, clean, melancholy, near-static locked macro camera, still-life. Only the seat surface and these two objects are visible; no windshield, no sky, no steering wheel, no driver — a tight still-life insert, not a portrait and not a wide cabin shot. Clean frame — no text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no pinyin anywhere in the image.
note: 反转物证:相框(苏晓笑)+褪色住院手环(名字+日期)。手环文字后期可补描清晰。

checks: 文字为道具印字非字幕·无水印
